case_name: Poonam Verma and Others v Delhi Development Authority
respondent:
Delhi Development Authority
Supreme Court of India

13 December 2007
Appeal (Civil) 5874 of 2007, (Arising out of S.L.P. (Civil) No. 1322 of 2007)
The Judgment was delivered by: S. B. Sinha, J.
1. Leave granted.
2. Respondent is an authority created under the Delhi Development Act, 1957 (for short the Act ). the Act was enacted to provide for the development of Delhi according to plan and for matters connected therewith or ancillary thereto.
Respondent floated a scheme known as Fifth Self Financing Housing Registration Scheme, 1982 (for short the Scheme ). Appellants herein pursuant to an advertisement issued in this behalf registered themselves; their registration numbers being 13463, 16602 and 13464. For the purpose of allotment of flats, lots were drawn on various occasions, viz., in June, 1987, November, 1987, March, 1989, July, 1990, January, 1991, January, 1993.
